targetTexts.1: The king’s heart is a waterway in the hand of the LORD; He directs it where He pleases.
targetTexts.2: All a man’s ways seem right to him, but the LORD weighs the heart.
targetTexts.3: To do righteousness and justice is more desirable to the LORD than sacrifice.
targetTexts.4: Haughty eyes and a proud heart—the guides of the wicked—are sin.
targetTexts.5: The plans of the diligent bring plenty, as surely as haste leads to poverty.
targetTexts.6: Making a fortune by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist, a deadly pursuit.
targetTexts.7: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away because they refuse to do what is just.
targetTexts.8: The way of a guilty man is crooked, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
targetTexts.9: Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
targetTexts.10: The soul of the wicked man craves evil; his neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.
targetTexts.11: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; and when a wise man is instructed, he acquires knowledge.
targetTexts.12: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.
targetTexts.13: Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor, he too shall cry out and receive no answer.
targetTexts.14: A gift in secret soothes anger, and a covert bribe pacifies great wrath.
targetTexts.15: Justice executed is a joy to the righteous, but a terror to the workers of iniquity.
targetTexts.16: The man who strays from the path of understanding will rest in the assembly of the dead.
targetTexts.17: He who loves pleasure will become poor; the one who loves wine and oil will never be rich.
targetTexts.18: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the faithless for the upright.
targetTexts.19: Better to live in the desert than with a contentious and ill-tempered wife.
targetTexts.20: Precious treasures and oil are in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man consumes them.
targetTexts.21: He who pursues righteousness and loving devotion finds life, righteousness, and honor.
targetTexts.22: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.
targetTexts.23: He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress.
targetTexts.24: Mocker is the name of the proud and arrogant man—of him who acts with excessive pride.
targetTexts.25: The craving of the slacker kills him because his hands refuse to work.
targetTexts.26: All day long he covets more, but the righteous give without restraint.
targetTexts.27: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable—how much more so when brought with ill intent!
targetTexts.28: A lying witness will perish, but the man who listens to truth will speak forever.
targetTexts.29: A wicked man hardens his face, but the upright man makes his way sure.
targetTexts.30: There is no wisdom, no understanding, no counsel that can prevail against the LORD.
targetTexts.31: A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the LORD.
